title: DMB-X: Dual Mesh Benchmark Multi-Engine Extension - Eight Engine Columns on the Frozen B1 Corpus (126/126 Measured Instances Correct; Availability Partials Disclosed)
description:
The Dual Mesh Benchmark multi-engine extension (DMB-X): eight engine columns measured on the frozen B1 corpus, extending DMB v1.0 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23303081), v2.0 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23321637), and the DeepSeek v4-pro column (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23345241).

PROTOCOL (preregistered before execution, commit b293d58): frozen corpus CORPUS_B1.json (sha256 13295d197be59dd1266814bc2f961f1e55e974c61c642fd9c7a6a389668fee59), first-20-in-file-order selection rule, byte-identical prompt contract to the DeepSeek B1 leg, one representative engine per family via OpenRouter raw API, fresh stateless request per instance, wall-clock request-to-full-response, raw responses preserved verbatim per instance. All five falsifiers held: raw logs preserved, frozen corpus/selection verified at run time, no distribution-improving retries, no post-hoc metrics, no silent engine substitutions.

RESULTS (20 instances per leg, total spend $0.0779):
- openai/gpt-mini-latest: 20/20 correct, median 1212.2 ms
- anthropic/claude-haiku-latest: 20/20 correct (strict 19, normalized 20), median 2246.0 ms
- google/gemini-flash-latest: 20/20 correct, median 4438.8 ms
- qwen/qwen3.8-omni-flash: 20/20 correct, median 4744.8 ms
- mistralai/mistral-small-3.2-24b-instruct: 20/20 correct, median 2764.1 ms
- deepseek/deepseek-flash-latest: 20/20 correct, median 1196.5 ms
- meta-llama/llama-4-scout: PARTIAL-AVAILABILITY - 4/20 measured, 4/4 correct, median 13588.4 ms; 16 instances upstream rate-limited (HTTP 429, DeepInfra) across the first leg and a disclosed 45-second-paced resume; capability clean on every instance that landed; recorded as UNAVAILABLE-rate-limited, not capability-failed
- x-ai/grok-4.7: PARTIAL - 2/3 measured, 2/2 correct, median 2910.3 ms; third call aborted by HTTP 402 in-flight-budget payment error (recorded verbatim, never retried per protocol)

FINDING: the frozen decision-tuple contract is engine-portable - every instance any engine actually returned (126/126 across seven families, plus the earlier DeepSeek v4-pro column) was valid and correct. Median latency spread within the raw-API substrate: 1212-13588 ms. Per XPLAT-2/3 doctrine, raw-API wall-clock medians are not comparable to conversation-loop medians; cross-substrate comparison is directional only.

Dual Mesh Benchmark section: MEASURED - DeepSeek v4-pro column (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23345241); plus the eight engine columns of this record (seven full or availability-partial, one payment-partial), raw-API substrate. NOT MEASURED - the conversation-loop per-model matrix (XPLAT-4) remains blocked by a platform model-pin limitation; the platform mesh columns remain as documented in DMB v2.0.
